articles.title: Ancient humans used fire way earlier than we thought!
articles.summary: Scientists found burnt bones in a South African cave that show Homo erectus used fire up to 1.8 million years ago. That's almost twice as old as the previous record. Cool, right?

articles.title: Why are we ticklish? Scientists made a body map!
articles.summary: Researchers asked people from China, the Netherlands, and Greece where they're ticklish. They found the neck, armpits, belly, and feet are most ticklish—and it's the same across cultures!

articles.title: New compound burns fat without losing muscle!
articles.summary: Scientists found a compound called TOFA that helps mice lose fat but keep muscle. It works differently from popular weight-loss drugs like Ozempic. Could be a new way to fight obesity!
